crossRefs.note: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

translations.web: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
translations.bsb: and the outer chambers was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.
translations.kjv: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
translations.asv: And between the chambers was a breadth of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
